title: Minter
tagline: It lets you mint NFTs of trees. You can mint tree NFTs with the project. The NFT will be a TeamTree NFT.
description: It lets you mint NFTs of trees. You can mint tree NFTs with the project. The NFT will be a TeamTree NFT. The project is built in Next.js. The smart contract is written in Solidity. It is deployed on the Avalanche network. You have to connect your Metamask wallet and add Avalanche chain to it.
